verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents installation from a prebuilt Docker image (`localai/localai:latest`), with no compiling from source. It also describes itself as "one binary" and automatically downloads the right prebuilt GPU backend, which supports the prebuilt-artifact story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of downloadable prebuilt binaries or OS packages (e.g. release assets, Homebrew/apt), install instructions beyond the Docker one-liner, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it.
LocalAI automatically detects your system's GPU capabilities (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) and downloads the appropriate backend.
